visual_description: The image displays a 3x3 grid of nine black-and-white historical portraits featuring African American individuals and groups from the late 19th or early 20th century. Subjects include men in formal suits with high collars and mustaches, women in period dresses with lace, fur stoles, and feathered hats, and one group photo of three young women. Some portraits are oval-framed; others are rectangular studio shots with decorative backdrops. A green diagonal overlay partially covers the middle row. At bottom right, small text reads “NOVEMBER/DECEMBER 2024 LOC.GOV/LCM” alongside a red page number “83.” No charts, tables, axes, or data labels are present. The crop is clear and legible.
